record.original_question: Does there exist an asymptotically good family of cyclic binary linear codes, meaning a sequence of codes [n_i, k_i, d_i] for which both lim inf_i→∞ k_i/n_i > 0 and lim inf_i→∞ d_i/n_i > 0 hold?

evidence.quote: Let us recall that a sequence of linear binary [ni, ki, di] codes Ci is asymptotically good if both lim inf ki/ni > 0, and lim inf di/ni > 0.
Open Question 13.1. Are cyclic codes asymptotically good?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A binary linear code of length $n$, dimension $k$, and minimum Hamming distance $d$ is denoted $[n,k,d]$. Such a code $C \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$ is called cyclic if $(c_0, c_1, \dots, c_{n-1}) \in C$ implies $(c_{n-1}, c_0, \dots, c_{n-2}) \in C$. A sequence of binary linear codes $C_i$ with parameters $[n_i, k_i, d_i]$ (with $n_i \to \infty$) is called asymptotically good if
$$\liminf_{i \to \infty} \frac{k_i}{n_i} > 0 \quad \text{and} \quad \liminf_{i \to \infty} \frac{d_i}{n_i} > 0.$$
Question: Does there exist an asymptotically good sequence of binary cyclic linear codes?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether binary cyclic codes are asymptotically good is a well-known long-standing open problem (over 50 years old). Partial and related results exist: quasi-cyclic codes (index >1) are known to be asymptotically good, certain additive cyclic codes and $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-additive cyclic codes have been shown asymptotically good, and long BCH codes are known asymptotically bad. The original problem for (ordinary) binary cyclic codes remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotically Good Additive Cyclic Codes Exist
status_evidence.snippet: Long-standing open problem whether cyclic codes are asymptotically good; this paper shows additive cyclic codes are.
status_evidence.claim: The asymptotic goodness of (ordinary) cyclic codes remains open; related additive variants resolved.

status_evidence.title: Is the class of cyclic codes asymptotically good?
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates the long-open question of whether cyclic codes are asymptotically good.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is identified as a long-standing open question in coding theory.

status_evidence.title: Z2Z4-Additive Cyclic Codes Are Asymptotically Good
status_evidence.snippet: Partial progress: Z2Z4-additive cyclic codes are asymptotically good.
status_evidence.claim: Partial/related results exist but the original cyclic codes problem remains open.
